callback_url.description: URL that receives the final verification result.

events_callback_url.description: URL that receives verification progress events.

search_businesses.title: Search businesses
search_businesses.description: Search official registries for businesses by name in a country (and state), to autofill onboarding. Returns registry data only; nothing is verified.

state_code.description: State or region code, e.g. for US companies.

lookup_business.title: Look up a business
lookup_business.description: Fetch a business's full registry record -- registration, related persons and events -- by the id a search returned. No verification is performed.

business_entity_id.description: Company number / registration number from search result (required for US).

company_id.description: Company identifier from search results. Use this for lookup when returned in search.

state_code.description: State or region code, e.g. for US companies.

check_government_lookup_status.title: Check a government lookup's status
check_government_lookup_status.description: Check whether a country's government ID lookup for a given ID type is currently available.

id_type.description: ID type, e.g. a national ID or tax number type.

list_id_number_checks.title: List ID number checks
list_id_number_checks.description: List every government ID-number verification AiPrise offers, grouped by country.

trigger_pdf_report.title: Generate a PDF report
trigger_pdf_report.description: Start generating a PDF report for a verification session or a profile -- give exactly one. Poll get_pdf_report with the returned job id.

profile_id.description: User or business profile to report on.

get_pdf_report.title: Get a PDF report
get_pdf_report.description: Poll a PDF job; once COMPLETED the response is the PDF itself. Poll about every five seconds, for up to two minutes.

output.description: The job status, or the PDF bytes when complete.
